tasks.label: dev: stellar app
tasks.command: if (Test-NetConnection 127.0.0.1 -Port 3001 -InformationLevel Quiet) { Write-Host 'Stellar already running on 3001'; exit 0 }; do { $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($conn) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '[stellar] cleared stale process on 3001'; Start-Sleep 1 }; Write-Host '[stellar] starting...'; Set-Location D:\stellar-mvp-deploy; npm run dev:once; Write-Host '[stellar] crashed or stopped — restarting in 3s...'; Start-Sleep 3 } while ($true)
